name: ODE Phase Portrait
desc: A living phase portrait of a 2D differential equation — fifteen hundred tracer particles stream along the vector field toward spirals, saddles, limit-cycles and centres, hued by speed over faint nullclines and glowing fixed points, the flow topology transforming from pendulum to Van der Pol to Duffing to predator-prey as the sections turn.

scale.doc: phase-space zoom (bigger = closer on the fixed points)

hue.doc: palette base hue (speed ramps around it)
